LESSON: FRACTIONS

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.1: Fractions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Fractions. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-212.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 212]]

From your pupil's book (page 212)

2. Which is bigger? a) or?____ b) or? ____

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-033.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 33]]

From your pupil's book (page 33)

fractions Week 3 Lesson 3 Half as part of a whole

A fraction tells us how many parts of a whole we have.

Activity 1 In groups cut circular One cut-outs from manilla whole paper.

Fold the circular cut-out into two equal parts and cut.

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-3/mathematics/page-038.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3 — page 38]]

From your pupil's book (page 38)

Week 4 Lesson 1 Fraction as part of a group We have learnt that a fraction is a part of a whole. A fraction can also be a part of a group.

Activity 1 Form a group of 6 bottle tops with three black and three red. We have two small groups. Out of the two, one group is shaded red.

What part of the group is girls? ______ What part of the group is boys? ______

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Fractions means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Fractions.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Fractions
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 3
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
